title: Marathon FL Sandbar Cruise & Sightseeing Adventure
includes: Kayaks, Paddle Boards, Lily Pad, Floats
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the charm of Marathon, FL, with a delightful Sandbar Experience and Sightseeing Cruise. Enjoy a 4-hour adventure exploring the local scenery on a comfortable boat, complete with unique views of the island. Spend a relaxing day at the sandbar, where you can swim in the crystal-clear waters, or opt for kayaking and paddleboarding to enhance your aquatic adventure. Light snacks, drinks, and friendly crew members ensure a fun-filled day for all ages.

- 4-hour tour ideal for families and all ages
- Scenic boat ride to the sandbar with opportunities for swimming and water sports
- Light snacks and drinks provided; guests can bring their own food (no glass or hard alcohol)
- Relaxed atmosphere with ample time to enjoy the beautiful waters and surroundings
